title: 第10章 遭遇野猪，屁股破了
slug: 乱世武道从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

站在洞穴外的。

竟然又是一头花豹。

它嘴里叼着一头獐子。

上百斤的重量对它来说，似乎不值一提。

再看爪子。

陆林的目光一凝。

右前爪有一大块黑色的皮肤，其下骨骼粗大，与原本的爪子结合在一起，看起来有些怪异。

这才是跟陆林打过一场的花豹。

之前被杀死的，应该是它的伴侣。

花豹看到陆林。

眼中闪过一抹杀意。

随即，它又看到陆林身上背着的另一只花豹！

当下就松了口，将那獐子甩出去，低吼一声，红着眼睛飞扑过来。

该死的人类！

陆林爆退。

挥出那一把破损的钢刀。

刀锋划过花豹的右前爪。

竟然发出了金铁交鸣之声。

陆林心里咯噔一下，这花豹的爪子，不仅一天之内长好，变得更加粗壮，还拥有了金属一般的质感。

一人一豹相撞瞬间分开。

陆林只觉得虎口发麻。

花豹之前没有这么大的力气！

“吼！”

花豹再吼。

他低伏身体，如同一道黄黑色的闪电，贴着地面杀来。

陆林赶忙用脚去踢。

却被花豹一口咬住。

“额……”

脚上一疼，陆林不管不顾，挥刀砍下。

一刀破开了花豹的后颈。

可这花豹也不知道发了什么疯，明明吃痛，却是死也不肯松口。

陆林连着几刀戳下去。

花豹已经断气。

可那尖锐的牙齿还是咬在陆林的鞋子上。

陆林把刀丢下，用力掰开花豹的嘴，这才把脚拿出来。

鞋子没破。

这鞋子是之前陆大虎的，棉鞋外面又套了一层兽皮，就是防止野兽撕咬，夏天就光脚穿着，也不用怕毒虫毒蛇。

今天是这双兽皮鞋救了陆林。

把脚拔出来一看，只是大拇指和脚背有一些挫伤，并不影响行动。

“哼哼，你这家伙还想报仇，没想到自己身死不说，还送我一头獐子。”

陆林重新穿上鞋子，看着满地的猎物，眼中露出喜色。

两头花豹，一头獐子，一只灰兔。

灰兔吃掉。

完好的花豹和獐子可以拿去镇上卖钱。

至于那一头皮毛损坏严重的，回头让嫂嫂处理一下，做个马甲。

实在不行，做个手套帽子也好。

陆林扛起猎物，沉甸甸的压在肩头。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Standing outside the cave.

It turned out to be another leopard.

It held a deer in its mouth.

The weight of hundreds of kilograms seems not worth mentioning to it.

Look at the claws again.

Lu Lin's eyes narrowed.

There is a large piece of black skin on the right front paw, and the bones under it are thick, which combined with the original claw looks a bit weird.

This is the leopard who fought with Lu Lin.

The one that was killed before should be its mate.

Hua Bao saw Lu Lin.

There was a flash of killing intent in his eyes.

Immediately, it saw another leopard carried by Lu Lin!

Immediately he relaxed, threw the deer away, roared, and flew towards him with red eyes.

Damn humans!

Lu Lin retreated violently.

Swing out the broken steel knife.

The blade scratched the leopard's right front paw.

There was a sound of gold and iron clashing.

Lu Lin's heart skipped a beat. The leopard's claws not only grew in one day, becoming thicker, but also had a metallic texture.

A man and a leopard were separated instantly when they collided.

Lu Lin only felt the tiger's mouth numb.

The leopard had never had such strength before!

"Roar!"

The leopard roars again.

He lowered his body, like a yellow-black lightning, and struck close to the ground.

Lu Lin hurriedly kicked it with his feet.

But he was bitten by a leopard.

"Um..."

When his foot hurt, Lu Lin ignored it and chopped it off with his knife.

The knife broke the leopard's back neck.

But this leopard didn't know why he was crazy. He was obviously in pain, but he refused to let go until he died.

Lu Lin stabbed him several times.

The leopard has expired.

But the sharp teeth still bit Lu Lin's shoes.

Lu Lin dropped the knife, opened the leopard's mouth with force, and then took out his feet.

The shoes are not torn.

These shoes belonged to Lu Dahu before. The cotton shoes were covered with a layer of animal skin to prevent them from being bitten by wild animals. They could be worn barefoot in the summer without fear of venomous insects or snakes.

It was this pair of animal skin shoes that saved Lu Lin today.

When I pulled the foot out, I found that there were only some contusions on the thumb and instep, which did not affect my movement.

"Hmph, you guys still want to take revenge, but you didn't expect that you would die without telling me, and you would give me a deer."

Lu Lin put on his shoes again and looked at the prey on the ground with joy in his eyes.

Two leopards, a deer, and a gray rabbit.

The gray rabbit ate it.

The intact leopards and deer can be sold in the town for money.

As for the severely damaged hair, I will ask my sister-in-law to take care of it later and make a vest.

If that doesn't work, I might as well make a glove or hat.

Lu Lin picked up the prey, which was heavy on his shoulders.
